label: Importing and exporting goods: customs, containers and landed cost
description: Customs declarations and clearance, commercial invoices for export, bonded goods, tracking containers in transit and spreading freight, duty and insurance onto the real cost of imported items.
statements: Importing and exporting goods: customs, containers and landed cost
Customs declarations and clearance, commercial invoices for export, bonded goods, tracking containers in transit and spreading freight, duty and insurance onto the real cost of imported items.
Our goods cross borders and customs paperwork is done outside BC.
We retype order data into the customs broker's system for every shipment.
Each export needs a commercial invoice that meets the destination country's rules.
We use a bonded warehouse and must exchange data with our customs agent.
We need to know which purchase orders are on which container and when it lands.
Freight, duty and insurance are not on the item cost until the invoices arrive months later.
We cannot see what an imported item really cost us once everything is added.
Our margins are wrong because landed cost is estimated in a spreadsheet.
